The Destination

Nosy Ankazoberavina

Tucked away off the north-west coast of Madagascar, Nosy Ankazoberavina is a secluded island paradise offering an intimate and immersive escape into nature. Located within easy reach of Nosy Be, yet worlds apart in atmosphere, this small private island is defined by its untouched forests, rich marine ecosystems and sense of complete tranquillity.

Often described as a true hidden gem, Nosy Ankazoberavina is ideal for travellers seeking exclusivity, authenticity and a deep connection with Madagascar’s natural environment.

Natural Beauty

Nature & Wildlife

Despite its small size, Nosy Ankazoberavina boasts remarkable biodiversity. The island is covered in pristine tropical forest and surrounded by coral reefs teeming with marine life. Its unique ecosystem supports a variety of species, including lemurs, chameleons, nesting sea turtles and the rare Madagascar fish eagle.

The surrounding waters of the Mozambique Channel are rich in marine biodiversity, with dolphins frequently spotted and seasonal visitors such as humpback whales passing through during migration months. With no crowds and minimal development, the island offers a rare opportunity to experience Madagascar’s wildlife and landscapes in a peaceful and unspoilt setting.

Experiences

Things to Do in Nosy Ankazoberavina

Snorkelling & Diving

Encircled by coral reefs, the island offers excellent snorkelling directly from the shore. Clear waters reveal vibrant coral gardens, tropical fish and occasional sightings of turtles and rays.

Sailing & Catamaran Experiences

The island is perfectly positioned for ocean exploration, with opportunities to combine a land-based stay with sailing adventures through the Nosy Be archipelago.

Nature Walks & Wildlife Encounters

Walking trails wind through the island’s forest, offering opportunities to spot endemic wildlife including lemurs, chameleons and the rare Madagascar fish eagle.

Fishing & Ocean Activities

The surrounding waters are ideal for sport fishing, with species such as tuna and other pelagic fish found in abundance.

Boat Excursions & Island Hopping

Explore nearby islands including Nosy Tanikely and Nosy Iranja by traditional pirogue, accessing remote beaches and diverse marine environments.

Whale & Dolphin Watching

During the migration season, humpback whales can be seen in the surrounding waters, while dolphins are regular visitors year-round.

Where to Stay

Accommodation in Nosy Ankazoberavina

Accommodation on Nosy Ankazoberavina is designed to blend seamlessly with the island’s natural surroundings, offering a unique eco-luxury experience focused on privacy, sustainability and authenticity.

Boutique beachfront bungalows set discreetly within tropical vegetation, often just steps from the ocean
Traditional architecture using natural materials, thoughtfully integrated into the environment
A small number of accommodations ensuring exclusivity and personalised service
Off-grid elements with a focus on sustainability and minimal environmental impact
Fresh, locally inspired cuisine and relaxed communal spaces overlooking the sea
Some accommodation experiences on the island are combined with ocean-based exploration, allowing guests to enjoy both land and sea. This flexible approach creates a dynamic and enriching stay.

As part of a curated journey with The Madagascar Collection, a stay on Nosy Ankazoberavina pairs beautifully with nearby islands and mainland experiences, offering a diverse and unforgettable exploration of Madagascar’s coastal treasures.

Highlights

  • Pristine tropical forest & coral reefs
  • Rare Madagascar fish eagle sightings
  • Lemurs, chameleons & nesting sea turtles
  • Dolphins year-round & humpback whales (seasonal)
  • Excellent snorkelling directly from shore
  • Sport fishing in rich Mozambique Channel waters
  • Sailing & catamaran exploration
  • Eco-luxury accommodation — small & exclusive

When to Visit

May – October
Dry season. Best conditions for snorkelling, diving and wildlife encounters.
July – September
Humpback whale migration — spectacular sightings possible.
Year-Round
Dolphins, turtles and birdlife are present throughout the year.

Combine With

  • Nosy Be — island base & excursions
  • Nosy Komba — lemur forest walks
  • Nosy Iranja — the iconic sandbar
  • Nosy Sakatia — turtle snorkelling
